description: VSC STATCOM: IGBT conduction + switching losses split from F1a bulk loss_factor; temperature-dependent on-state resistance; transformer copper losses; symmetric +/-Q capability maintained regardless of V.

unit.name: Generic ±100 MVAR MMC-STATCOM, 132 kV
unit.source: Hingorani & Gyugyi (2000) Ch.6; Cigre TB 401 (2009) VSC Transmission; Bahrman & Johnson (2007) IEEE Power&Energy; IEC 62927:2018 VSC STATCOM standard; Semikron IGBT Application Manual (2021).

V_dc_kV.note: DC link voltage (typical MMC sub-module equivalent)

IGBT_V_ce0.note: IGBT threshold voltage V_ce0 at T_j=125C

IGBT_r_ce.note: IGBT differential on-resistance r_ce at T_j=125C

IGBT_T_j_ref.note: Reference junction temperature for IGBT params

IGBT_E_sw.note: Total switching energy (E_on+E_off) per pulse at V_ref, I_ref

n_IGBT_per_phase.note: Active IGBTs per phase (simplified; MMC: ~72 SMs but equivalent 6 switches)

T_j.note: Default junction temperature for loss calculation
